title: Mutants & Meltdowns
about: The world ended in the Big Oops. Now you're a mutant, a beastling, a walking plant, a rusty robot, or just a lucky normal — poking glowing Ancient relics with a stick. Load it, then try a 'Start as...'.

classes.name: Scavenger

look.tagline: Finds the shiny thing. Pokes the shiny thing.

gear: Scrap Blaster + a pouch of spare cells

look.tagline: The apocalypse rearranged your brain. For the better? Eh.

classes.name: Brute
gear: A door you use as a shield

card.name: Freaky Mutation
card.desc: Your body just... does something. Once per day, reroll any one d20 and keep the new number.

card.name: Glow in the Dark
card.desc: See in the dark up to 60 ft. Downside: you faintly glow, so sneaking is harder.

card.name: Claws & Fangs
card.desc: Bite and swipe: {STR} to hit, 1d6 damage. No weapon needed.

card.name: Critter Senses
card.desc: Your nose and ears are amazing. Advantage on Perception by smell or sound.

card.name: Photosynthesis
card.desc: Stand in the sun for 10 minutes to heal {LVL} HP. Plants gotta plant.

card.name: Bendy Stalk
card.desc: You're all vines and stem. Squeeze through any gap a cat could, and advantage on breaking free of grabs.

card.name: Built Different
card.desc: No need to eat, drink, sleep, or breathe. Poison and disease just ping off your chassis.

card.name: Self-Repair
card.desc: Clank yourself back together over a short rest: heal {LVL} HP.

card.name: Dumb Luck
card.desc: No mutations, just luck. Turn a miss into a hit, or a failed save into a pass.

card.name: Old-World Know-How
card.desc: You get Ancient tech. Advantage on figuring out relics, gadgets, and busted machines.

card.name: Scrounger
card.desc: You always find something. Start each adventure with one of your Gadgets already rigged up.

card.name: Jury-Rig
card.desc: Slap a fix on a busted thing or a busted buddy: heal 1d8+{DEXN}.

card.name: Overclock
card.desc: Push a gadget past the red line: use one Gadget a second time this turn, then it's fried until a short rest.

card.name: Dead Eye
card.desc: Your ranged shots ignore cover and deal +{PROF} damage. You don't miss much.

card.name: Mutant Mind
card.desc: Your powers run on brainwaves. Save DC {DC}, power attack {SPATK}.

card.name: Hot-Headed
card.desc: Once a turn, add +1d6 fire to any power that already deals damage. Your hair is probably on fire. It's fine.

card.name: Back-Seat Driver
card.desc: Whisper into one mind within 60 ft: {DC} Wis save or they waste their next action doing something silly.

card.name: Mutant Muscle
card.desc: FLEX! Go into a frenzy: {FURY} melee damage and you shrug off half of all damage until the fight ends.

card.name: Can't Stop Me
card.desc: While frenzied, nothing slows you down and you can't be knocked over or shoved. You just keep coming.

card.name: Reckless Smash
card.desc: Swing wild for advantage on melee attacks this turn. Everyone gets advantage hitting you back. Worth it.

options.name: Zap Gun
options.desc: Point and ZAP: {MANDC} Dex save or 1d10 lightning, 60 ft.

options.name: Grav Boots
options.desc: Float 20 ft up or across. Landings are gentle. Mostly.

options.name: Med-Spray
options.desc: Hisssss — heal a buddy you touch 1d8+{PROF}.

options.name: Force Shield
options.desc: A humming bubble: +1 Armor while it's switched on.

options.name: Boom Tube
options.desc: Lob it 60 ft: 15-ft blast, {MANDC} Dex save or 2d6 fire.

options.name: Stink Bomb
options.desc: Everyone within 10 ft: {MANDC} Con save or gag and miss their next attack.

card.desc: Zzzt! {SPATK} to hit for {CD}d8 lightning.
A punch of pure mind-force: {DC} Str save or shoved back 10 ft and knocked down.
Beam a nightmare into one head: {DC} Wis save or they run away from you on their turn.
Knit a wound shut: heal {S}+{MODN}.
card.name: Patch Up

card.desc: BWOMP — a bubble snaps up: +5 Armor until your next turn.
WHOOMPH! {DC} Dex save or {S} fire. Half on a save.
card.name: Firestarter

card.desc: Peek at the surface thoughts of one creature: {DC} Wis save or you know what it's about to do.
Hock a glob of mutant goo: {DC} Dex save or {S} acid and -2 Armor until they scrape it off.
card.name: Acid Spit

card.desc: Boing! Jump up to 60 ft in any direction. No fall damage when you land.
A rolling wave of green glow: {DC} Con save or {S} radiant and they feel sick (disadvantage on their next attack).
card.name: Rad Wave

card.desc: Flicker out of sight until your next turn, or until you attack. Spooky.
KA-THOOM. Everything in the blast: {DC} Dex save or {S} fire. Half on a save. Maybe stand back.
card.name: Meltdown

card.desc: Crack it open and chug: heal 2d4+2. Tastes like batteries and victory.
Unlabeled. Could be anything. Roll a d6: 1-2 you feel awful (disadvantage, 1 minute), 3-6 you feel GREAT: +10 temp HP.
WHOOSH — fly 60 ft this turn. The straps are only a little scorched.
Smear it on a wound, a wall, or a robot: heal or fix 3d8. Smells like a swamp.
An Ancient battery with way too much juice. Throw it 60 ft: 20-ft blast, Dex save (DC 15) or 6d6 fire. One use, obviously.

heroes.name: Spanner
heroes.notes: A friendly robot who names every gadget. This one's Kevin.

heroes.name: Fungus
heroes.notes: A walking shrub that knows what you're thinking. Says it's fine. It is not fine.

heroes.name: Grud
heroes.notes: Three arms, one plan: hit it. Surprisingly good at hugs.
